Markup check: all prices are already whole or half dollars with no consistent divisor onto a lower round number at 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25 - consistent with Blue Bottle's known flat-dollar pricing rather than a hidden delivery surcharge, but this is still a single delivery-marketplace source (tier 3) with no independent priced cross-check found, hence medium confidence rather than high. dishes.name: Espresso Beans
dishes.description: Espresso is neither a type of bean nor a roast, but a miraculous brewing method that creates a deeply concentrated coffee. Our Hayes Valley blend is our favorite for espresso—it makes a deep, dark, Italian-style shot with a voluptuous tawny crema and a somewhat dangerous-looking viscosity.

dishes.name: Blend Beans
dishes.description: Comforting and designed for pleasure, our blends combine coffees from different parts of the world to create a harmonious cup. Our blends are freshly roasted and sold as whole beans, not ground, for optimal deliciousness.

dishes.name: Single Origin Beans
dishes.description: We source coffee from all over the coffee-producing world, and we offer some standouts from distinctive regions and farms as single origins. These beans allow you to taste coffee from a specific time and place and are all about fleeting moments and the magic of surprise.

dishes.name: Craft Matcha
dishes.description: From the renowned matcha region of Uji, Japan, we bring you ceremonial-grade Craft Matcha. Our Kyoto team scoured Japan to find a matcha that embodies our standards for quality and taste. They found it at Rishouen, a teahouse born from five generations of tea knowledge. We choose tender tea leaves from Rishoueun’s first harvest of tencha, or shade-grown matcha plants, and stone-grind them to protect against heat degradation.

dishes.name: Craft Instant Coffee
dishes.description: We start with the highest-quality coffee, blend and roast to extract the espresso profile, then transform it into aromatic crystals with dimension and richness. The crystals dissolve instantly for consistently delicious iced or hot lattes that couldn’t be simpler to brew. Each jar includes 15 servings.

dishes.name: Ganache Hot Chocolate
dishes.description: Sweet and creamy dreaminess with a base of fresh milk (non-dairy alternatives are also available).

dishes.name: Breakfast Sandwich
dishes.description: Start your morning right with our bold and flavorful breakfast sandwich. Fluffy baked egg, chives, and a zesty Fresno chile relish come together on rustic sourdough, perfectly toasted and topped with melty sharp white cheddar. It’s a satisfying balance of heat, tang, and creamy goodness. Add bacon for extra protein.

dishes.name: Wafel
dishes.description: An ideal portable breakfast or snack, our wafels have a caramelized crust that makes syrup unnecessary.

dishes.name: Pour Over
dishes.description: Our coffees are brewed with careful attention to detail so you always get a delicious cup. Choose from a cozy blend or a lively single origin.

dishes.name: Iced Tea
dishes.description: Our full-bodied teas from Steven Smith Teamaker pair wonderfully with milk and sugar and are balanced enough to enjoy on their own. Choose from our organic British Brunch Full Leaf Black Tea, Sencha Full Leaf Green Tea, or Sea to Mountain Herbal Infusion featuring Oregon peppermint, South American cacao nibs, Indian sarsaparilla, and fragrant osmanthus from China.

dishes.name: Latte
dishes.description: A latte is a coffee drink made with espresso and steamed milk. Latte is the short form of the Italian caffe latte, which means milk coffee. It is milkier than a cappuccino. (price varies by size/option, $6.00-$8.00, recorded lowest)

dishes.name: Drip Coffee
dishes.description: One of many methods to brew coffee. With the drip method, where hot water is run through the coffee grounds which are held in a paper filter, you may find a nice bouquet of flavors and aroma that's not otherwise available in espresso. (price varies by size/option, $5.00-$6.00, recorded lowest)

dishes.name: Double Shot
dishes.description: The name says all: an espresso is to be freshly prepared and enjoyed immediately. Expressly! For coffee purists, espresso is the quintessential coffee preparation – rich, aromatic and velvety all at once; a natural layer of crema on top belying a full-bodied, yet deftly balanced liquid below.

dishes.name: Mocha
dishes.description: A caffè mocha, also called mocaccino, is a chocolate-flavored variant of a caffè latte. The name is derived from the city of Mocha, Yemen, which was one of the centers of early coffee trade. Like a caffè latte, caffè mocha is based on espresso and hot milk but with added chocolate flavoring. (price varies by size/option, $6.50-$8.50, recorded lowest)

dishes.name: Americano
dishes.description: Caffè americano or americano is a type of coffee drink prepared by diluting an espresso with hot water, giving it a similar strength to, but different flavor from traditionally brewed coffee. Hot water topped with a double espresso. (price varies by size/option, $5.00-$6.50, recorded lowest)

dishes.name: Cold Brew
dishes.description: Unlike regular coffee, cold brew is never exposed to heat. Cold brew uses time, rather than heat to extract the coffee's oils, sugars, and caffeine. Therefor cold brew tastes different than iced coffee, which is made with “hot-brewed” (AKA: regular) coffee. (price varies by size/option, $6.00-$7.00, recorded lowest)

dishes.name: Cortado
dishes.description: A cortado is a beverage consisting of espresso mixed with a roughly equal amount of warm milk to reduce the acidity. The milk in a cortado is steamed, but not frothy and "texturized" as in many other Italian coffee drinks.

dishes.name: Macchiato
dishes.description: Caffè macchiato, sometimes called espresso macchiato, is an espresso coffee drink with a small amount of milk, usually foamed. In Italian, macchiato means "stained" or "spotted" so the literal translation of caffè macchiato is "stained coffee", or coffee with a spot of milk.

dishes.name: Cappuccino
dishes.description: Cappuccino is an espresso-based coffee drink that originated in Italy, and is traditionally prepared with steamed milk foam (microfoam). Cappuccino is traditionally small with a thick layer of foam, while "latte" traditionally is larger. (price varies by size/option, $5.00-$6.00, recorded lowest)

dishes.name: Matcha
dishes.description: Matcha, which literally means "powdered tea", is finely ground powder of specially grown and processed green tea leaves. This premium green tea powder is used for drinking as tea or as an ingredient in recipes. (price varies by size/option, $6.50-$8.00, recorded lowest)
